Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Arrays may be in any order; include every requested group. A zero numerator is not missing data. No web or network access is needed.

Investigate parcel-index on 2026-05-02, comparing reference 10:00–11:00 with incident 11:00–12:00. In assessment, identify the most strongly supported proximal explanation, the affected pool and the terminal-failure increase in percentage points; contrast it with at least one plausible alternative. arguments.command:
cd /work; cat > ops.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ops AS (
  SELECT o.operation_id, o.opened_at_ms, r.pool_id, p.deadline_ms,
         CASE WHEN o.opened_at_ms>=1777719600000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1777723200000 THEN 'reference_10_11'
              WHEN o.opened_at_ms>=1777723200000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1777726800000 THEN 'incident_11_12' END AS period
  FROM logical_operations o
  JOIN service_routes sr ON sr.route_id=o.route_id AND sr.service_id=1
  JOIN route_assignments r ON r.route_id=o.route_id AND o.opened_at_ms>=r.effective_from_ms AND o.opened_at_ms<r.effective_to_ms
  JOIN policy_profiles p ON p.profile_id=r.profile_id
  WHERE o.opened_at_ms>=1777719600000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1777726800000
),
att AS (
  SELECT a.operation_id, COUNT(*) n, SUM(fc.is_success=0) failed,
         MAX(CASE WHEN a.attempt_no=(SELECT MAX(attempt_no) FROM attempt_events x WHERE x.operation_id=a.operation_id) THEN fc.is_success END) final_success
  FROM attempt_events a JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=a.code_id GROUP BY a.operation_id
)
SELECT ops.period, wp.pool_code, COUNT(*) operations,
  SUM(att.final_success=0) terminal_failures,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(att.final_success=0)/COUNT(*),4) terminal_failure_pct,
  SUM(att.n) attempts, SUM(att.failed) failed_attempts,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(att.failed)/SUM(att.n),4) attempt_failure_pct,
  SUM(att.n>1) retried_operations, MIN(ops.deadline_ms) min_deadline_ms, MAX(ops.deadline_ms) max_deadline_ms
FROM ops JOIN att USING(operation_id) JOIN worker_pools wp ON wp.pool_id=ops.pool_id
GROUP BY ops.period, wp.pool_code ORDER BY ops.period, wp.pool_code;
EOF
sqlite3 -header /data/current.db < ops.sql

select CASE WHEN measured_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND measured_at_ms<1777719600000 THEN 'reference_10_11' WHEN measured_at_ms>=1777719600000 AND measured_at_ms<1777723200000 THEN 'incident_11_12' END period, wp.pool_code, ts.signal_code, ts.unit, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(value),4) mean_value, MIN(measured_at_ms), MAX(measured_at_ms)

arguments.command:
cd /work; cat > mech.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ops AS (
  SELECT o.operation_id, o.opened_at_ms, r.pool_id, p.deadline_ms,
         CASE WHEN o.opened_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1777719600000 THEN 'reference_10_11'
              WHEN o.opened_at_ms>=1777719600000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1777723200000 THEN 'incident_11_12' END AS period
  FROM logical_operations o
  JOIN route_assignments r ON r.route_id=o.route_id AND o.opened_at_ms>=r.effective_from_ms AND o.opened_at_ms<r.effective_to_ms
  JOIN policy_profiles p ON p.profile_id=r.profile_id
  WHERE o.opened_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND o.opened_at_ms<1777723200000
)
SELECT ops.period, wp.pool_code, a.attempt_no, fc.code, COUNT(*) attempts,
  ROUND(AVG(a.queue_ms),1) avg_queue, ROUND(AVG(a.execution_ms),1) avg_exec, MIN(a.execution_ms), MAX(a.execution_ms)
FROM ops JOIN attempt_events a USING(operation_id) JOIN failure_codes fc ON fc.code_id=a.code_id JOIN worker_pools wp ON wp.pool_id=ops.pool_id
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,1,3,4;
EOF
sqlite3 -header /data/current.db < mech.sql; sqlite3 /data/current.db "select signal_id, count(distinct value), min(value), max(value) from telemetry_samples group by 1; "

arguments.command:
cd /work; cat > telemetry.sql <<'EOF'
SELECT CASE WHEN s.measured_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND s.measured_at_ms<1777719600000 THEN 'reference_10_11' WHEN s.measured_at_ms>=1777719600000 AND s.measured_at_ms<1777723200000 THEN 'incident_11_12' END AS period, wp.pool_code, ts.signal_code, ts.unit, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(s.value) AS mean_value FROM telemetry_samples s JOIN worker_pools wp ON wp.pool_id=s.pool_id JOIN telemetry_signals ts ON ts.signal_id=s.signal_id WHERE wp.pool_code IN ('idx-north','idx-south') AND s.measured_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND s.measured_at_ms<1777723200000 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,3,1;
EOF
cat > changes.sql <<'EOF'
SELECT k.kind_code, wp.pool_code, c.effective_at_ms, c.before_json, c.after_json FROM change_events c JOIN change_kinds k ON k.kind_id=c.kind_id LEFT JOIN worker_pools wp ON wp.pool_id=c.pool_id JOIN services sv ON sv.service_id=c.service_id WHERE sv.service_code='parcel-index' AND c.effective_at_ms>=1777716000000 AND c.effective_at_ms<1777723200000;
EOF
sqlite3 -header /data/current.db < telemetry.sql; sqlite3 -header /data/current.db < changes.sql
